_meta.purpose: Maps a civic issue category to the TYPE of authority responsible for it in India. This is jurisdiction-generic — it does not name a specific department, because that name changes per state/city. Combine this with data/raw/lgd/urban_local_bodies.csv (for ULB-level authorities) and data/departments/state_agencies.csv (for state-level utility boards) to resolve an actual department name for a given lat/lng.

authority_types.ULB_ENGINEERING: The urban local body's own civil engineering wing (roads, potholes, footpaths within municipal limits)
authority_types.ULB_SANITATION: The ULB's solid waste management / sanitation wing
authority_types.ULB_ELECTRICAL: The ULB's street lighting section (distinct from the state DISCOM, which handles supply to premises)
authority_types.ULB_HEALTH: The ULB's public health department (mosquito breeding, sanitation-linked disease)
authority_types.ULB_TOWN_PLANNING: The ULB's building-plan approval and illegal-construction enforcement wing
authority_types.ULB_ANIMAL_HUSBANDRY: The ULB's stray animal control wing
authority_types.STATE_WATER_BOARD: A state or city-level water & sewerage board, where one exists (see state_agencies.csv). Falls back to ULB_ENGINEERING or state PHED where no dedicated board exists.
authority_types.STATE_PHED: Public Health Engineering Department — handles water supply in states/rural areas without a dedicated water board
authority_types.STATE_DISCOM: The state electricity distribution company — handles supply faults, transformer issues, billing (distinct from ULB_ELECTRICAL streetlights)
authority_types.STATE_PWD: Public Works Department — state highways and roads outside municipal limits
authority_types.NHAI: National Highways Authority of India — national highways only
authority_types.TRAFFIC_POLICE: City traffic police — signals, signage, congestion
authority_types.REVENUE_DEPT: District Collector / Revenue Department — encroachment on government land, disputes
